## Type

- [ ] Documentation / research
- [ ] ADR (status: proposed / accepted / superseded)
- [ ] Schema or cross-repo contract change (list affected repositories)
- [ ] Code / scripts

## Checks

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_repo.py` passes locally (umbrella; or `--root <repo>` for a sibling)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Planned features are not described as implemented; no fake badges or compatibility claims

## Content and licensing

- [ ] No game files, extracted assets, AI derivatives of game assets, or screenshots of game content
- [ ] No model weights, secrets or `.env` files
- [ ] Upstream license texts and file headers preserved; no relicensing
- [ ] New third-party code/data/models are listed with source, version and license (for the licensing audit)
- [ ] Substantial AI assistance (code, docs or synthetic fixtures) is disclosed below
